description: This PHP source file defines the class ListLayoutMetaDataParser, which is responsible for parsing, managing, and deploying list view layout metadata for SugarCRM/SuiteCRM modules. It includes methods for retrieving default, additional, and available fields, handling layout deployment, and parsing request data to modify layout definitions.

classes.name: ListLayoutMetaDataParser
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing and managing list view layout metadata in SuiteCRM modules, including methods to retrieve different field sets, deploy layouts, and handle layout modifications from user requests.

methods.name: getDefaultFields
methods.description: Returns the list of default fields for the list view based on current view definitions.

methods.name: getAdditionalFields
methods.description: Returns additional fields available for creating new list view columns.

methods.name: getAvailableFields
methods.description: Returns fields that are not currently used in the list view but are available for addition.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Deploys the current layout, optionally updating it from the request data.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Returns the current view definitions for the list layout.

methods.name: getOriginalViewDefs
methods.description: Retrieves the original, unmodified view definitions.

methods.name: removeField
methods.description: Removes a specified field from the list view layout.

methods.name: getArrayDiff
methods.description: A static helper for array difference comparison, used internally to assist layout modifications.

methods.name: createViewDefsByFieldDefs
methods.description: Generates view definitions from field definitions, customizing behavior for specific field types.

methods.name: _populateFromRequest
methods.description: Updates the view definitions based on request data, typically after form submissions.

methods.name: isValidField
methods.description: Checks if a field is valid for inclusion in the list view based on its properties and current context.

methods.name: _trimFieldDefs
methods.description: Sanitizes and limits field definitions to essential attributes for list view display.
